Hi Ben / Laura,

We're lining up the maintenance window for the isolated EverMed cluster in northern CO. Two asks before we can schedule: a) confirmation of the signing key fingerprint you'll use to validate the image on site, and b) the proposed chain-of-custody for the physical media shipment (manifest + who hands off to whom).

We also need to confirm whether the cluster will accept a signed incremental image (v3.2 incremental patch) or requires a full image flash. The on-site team has limited time on 2026-09-03 — ideally we complete transfer and validation within a 3 hour window.

Can you send the manifest + signature and a short handover plan? If Secure Transit needs scheduling info, loop them in and we can confirm pickup.

Thanks,
Sam Ortega

Sam — thanks for the heads up. Quick answers up front:
- Signing key: we will use the field-provisioned signing key 'RW-FIELD-2026' (fingerprint: 8F:2B:61:...:C1). I attached the detached sig for the v3.2 image and the manifest we plan to ship.
- Update type: v3.2 is an incremental flash — about 1.8GB compressed. The on-site agent can apply incremental if the current baseline is v3.0 or v3.1; otherwise we will ship a full image by exception.
- Chain-of-custody: Secure Transit will collect from our staging facility and deliver to the on-site operations lead. The package will include a printed manifest + tamper tape and the sig file on a read-only USB.

Proposed window: 2026-09-03 08:00-11:00 MDT (Redwood engineers will be remote-standby 08:00-12:00 to validate). Please confirm the on-site contact and whether customs/logistics require additional documentation.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: signed-image-v3.2.tar.sig (signature, 1kb stub); manifest-v3.2.json (manifest, 2kb stub)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: disconnected-site update window and custody

Sam / Ben — a few operational constraints from our side:
1) KMS wrap: field team will not have network access to Redwood KMS. We'll provide a key-wrapped bundle (AES-KW) encrypted under the site's HSM public key. Aditya, can you confirm the wrap token format?
2) Signature verification: the on-site validator script expects the detached sig (sha256 with our RW-FIELD-2026 key) and will abort if manifest hash mismatches. Please ensure the on-site operator knows to run "./validate-image.sh --manifest manifest-v3.2.json --sig signed-image-v3.2.tar.sig"
3) Acceptance criteria: image loads, unit tests pass (basic health checks: /health, token-store read/write, model loading smoke test). If any smoke test fails, the site must retain current image and we will plan rollback.

Docusign: I'll send the final chain-of-custody acceptance form to EverMed (DocuSign record attached). Ops on your side should return the signed acceptance immediately after validation so we can clear the shipment record.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Field Deployments | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

Thanks all — confirming final plan and on-site checklist (copied below). Sam, please reply with the on-site operator name and mobile so Secure Transit can hand off.

On-site handover checklist (to be completed by Secure Transit + EverMed ops):
- Verify package seal and tamper tape intact (photo attached to the delivery note).
- Verify printed manifest matches manifest-v3.2.json (manifest hash: sha256: a3b9...f1c2).
- Provide operator with read-only USB containing signed-image-v3.2.tar.sig and validate-image.sh script.
- Operator runs: 
  1) ./validate-image.sh --manifest manifest-v3.2.json --sig signed-image-v3.2.tar.sig
  2) sudo dd if=image-v3.2.bin of=/dev/mmcblk0 bs=4M conv=fsync
  3) reboot and run smoke tests: /opt/redwood/bin/smoke-checks.sh
- If smoke checks fail, call Redwood incident line + escalate to Laura for rollback approval.

I am attaching the final manifest + the detached signature. Secure Transit: pickup 2026-09-02 10:00 from Redwood staging BLDG-4.

Aditya Rao
Field Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
